title: Machine and Orbit
author: Silas Almeida
blurb: Odile Voss, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
